title: "About"

Hello! This website is my public portfolio, using Quarto. This website also contains Python script, used to run embedded code. The table below shows the types and number of species found in Acadia National Park, Maine USA. The data was generated and downloaded from the NPS Mammal's website, which was further processed using PySpark's querying capabilities: 

```{python}
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark import sql

spark = SparkSession \
    .builder \
    .appName("Acadia Nation Park Species Table") \
    .config("spark.some.config.option", "some-value") \
    .getOrCreate()


species_df = spark.read.csv(
"./data/NPSpecies_FullList_ACAD_20260913_153745.csv",
    header=True,
    inferSchema=True
)

species_df.createOrReplaceTempView("Acadia_Species")

sql_query = """
SELECT CATEGORY as Species_Types , COUNT(CATEGORY) Number_Of_Species
FROM Acadia_Species
GROUP BY CATEGORY
"""
species = spark.sql(sql_query)

species.show()
```

# Reference:

U.S. Department of the Interior. (n.d.). Mammals. National Parks Service. https://www.nps.gov/acad/learn/nature/mammals.htm
